control.transition_metric: maximum fraction of opinions in any interval of configured width
control.transition_order_parameter_formula: max_x count_i(x_i in [x, x + window_width]) / N
control.transition_criterion: per-seed first forward-grid epsilon whose final order parameter >= 0.95

structure_only.triangle_protocol: none; edge-specific threshold on each proposed edge

structure_full.triangle_protocol: full-model trigger, three-edge gate and fallback

control.initialization: shared iid Uniform(0,1) opinions within each network seed
control.update_streams: same deterministic epsilon-specific update seed across variants; opinion states continue forward separately
